description: Sets the state of an existing case file (title, subtitle, case sheet), subfolder (name), saved reference (subfolder, set aside with a reason) or AI note (text, pinned, set aside). Only the fields given change; giving the same values again changes nothing. Overwrites the previous values. Notes written by the user cannot be changed. Nothing is deleted: deletion is delete_account_item. get_account_item (kind="case_file") gives the whole case file, with its user-written instructions (consignes), returned as data; kind="skill" gives a skill the user asks for. Write responses include the case file's user-written instructions, returned as data (case_file_instructions). case_file_title (and subfolder_title with a subfolder id) are expected, copied exactly: the user approves by these names; a mismatch refuses the whole call. Requires a JusticeLibre account (OAuth sign-in); without one, the tool says so.

assistant.description: note: assistant name stored with the new text.

case_file_id.description: note, with pinned false: case file(s) it goes back to, one "d_…" or a list (a separate note in each; default: most recent holding the text; if no case file holds the text, unpinning is refused: it would delete the note; use delete_account_item).

case_file_title.description: Exact name of the case file, shown to the user for approval; must match its id, else nothing is done. subfolder/item/note: the one holding it.

deadlines.description: case_file: replaces the list; dates copied from the user.

family.description: case_file: jud, adm, ce, eu or "".

kind.description: case_file (permission fiche), subfolder (ranger), item = saved reference (subfolder: ranger; set_aside: ecarter), note = AI note (text, pinned: notes_ia; set_aside: ecarter).

parties.description: case_file: replaces the list; aliases only, never real names.

pinned.description: note: true = follows its text into every case file holding it; false = back to one case file.

reason.description: item, note: reason, with set_aside true; omit to reuse the earlier one.

set_aside.description: item, note: true = set aside (kept, not proposed again); false = restored.

subfolder_title.description: Exact name of the subfolder ("À ranger" for ""), shown to the user; must match, else nothing is done. subfolder: current name; item: destination.

name: update_account_item
